declarations.name: OcelleBrandMark

members.name: ground
members.description:
The ground the mark sits on: `chrome` for the dark chrome grounds (`color-chrome`, `color-chrome-hover`); absent or
any other value for the main grounds. Reflected.

members.name: tone
members.description:
`mono` paints ring and spot in `currentColor`, the colour of the surrounding text, and wins over `ground`; absent
or any other value paints the variant of `ground`. Reflected.

members.name: label
members.description:
The accessible name of the mark, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as none, and without one the mark is
hidden from the accessibility tree. Not reflected.

slots.name: header
slots.description: The card's header, usually an `ocelle-section-header`, which a compact card draws at its compact size.

declarations.name: OcelleCard

members.name: density
members.description:
The card's density: `regular` or `compact`, whose padding and header-to-body gap are smaller and which draws a
section header in its `header` slot at the compact size. Not set, or any other value, draws regular. Reflected.

members.name: inset
members.description:
Draws the card on the inset ground, for a card nested inside another surface; present with any value is inset.
Changes nothing else. Reflected.

declarations.description: A card: a header slot above its body, in a regular or compact density, on the sheet or the inset ground.

slots.name: head
slots.description: The sidebar's head, the team or project it belongs to.
The sections, one element each (a `ul` of links, a `div`, an `ocelle-section-header`), drawn as padded blocks with a divider between each two.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: The sidebar's footer, kept at its block end.

members.name: label
members.description:
The name of the navigation landmark, trimmed, used while the host has no `aria-label`; empty or whitespace-only
counts as none, and the landmark is then unnamed. Not reflected.

declarations.description: A context sidebar: a navigation landmark holding a head, sections and a footer, ruled off from each other.

members.name: label

without one the icon is hidden from the accessibility tree. Not reflected.

slots.name: heading
slots.description: The page's own heading element (`h1` to `h6`, usually the screen's `h1`), drawn with the display style; its level is the page's.

slots.name: eyebrow
slots.description: A short label above the heading naming the area, drawn with the eyebrow style.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: The screen's controls at the inline end of the heading's first line, wrapping under the description when they do not fit beside the heading.

declarations.name: OcellePageHeader

members.name: size
members.description:
The heading's size: `regular` or `compact`. Not set, or any other value, draws regular, the heading at
`--ocelle-font-size-2xl`; `compact` draws it at `--ocelle-font-size-xl`. Reflected.

declarations.description:
A screen's page header: a band around a heading the page slots, with an optional eyebrow above, a description under
the heading and actions at its inline end, ruled off below.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description:
The heading's size: `regular` or `compact`. Not set, or any other value, draws regular, the heading at
`--ocelle-font-size-2xl`; `compact` draws it at `--ocelle-font-size-xl`. Reflected.

slots.name: heading
slots.description: The page's own heading element (`h1` to `h6`), drawn with the header's heading style; its level is the page's.

slots.name: eyebrow
slots.description: A short label above the heading, drawn with the eyebrow style; not rendered in the eyebrow variant.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Supporting text under the heading; not rendered in the eyebrow variant.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Controls at the inline end of the heading's first line, wrapping under the heading when they do not fit beside it.

declarations.name: OcelleSectionHeader

members.name: size
members.description:
The heading's size: `regular` or `compact`. Not set, or any other value, draws regular, or compact when the
header is in a compact card's `header` slot; a valid value wins over the card. No effect in the eyebrow variant.
Reflected.

members.name: variant
members.description:
`eyebrow` draws the heading with the eyebrow style and renders neither the eyebrow nor the description slot;
`default`, not set or any other value draws the default heading style. Reflected.

declarations.description:
A section header around a heading the page slots: an optional eyebrow above, a description under the heading and
actions at its inline end.

attributes.name: size

header is in a compact card's `header` slot; a valid value wins over the card. No effect in the eyebrow variant.
Reflected.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description:
`eyebrow` draws the heading with the eyebrow style and renders neither the eyebrow nor the description slot;
`default`, not set or any other value draws the default heading style. Reflected.
